latHint: Think the colour of chocolate and tree bark - not a nut tree.
pivHint: A HAZEL is a tree - but HAZEL is also the colour of some eyes, a light ______.
winText: Eye colour. HAZEL was the pivot - a nut tree to light BROWN.
lossText: BROWN - the colour of earth and wood. HAZEL was the pivot: a HAZEL tree to HAZEL eyes.
